prs.location: he well-established residential area of Mount Merrion is ideally situated close to Dublin City Centre, with excellent transport links ensuring easy access to every part of Dublin. Located just off the N11 Stillorgan Road, Oatlands Manor connects seamlessly to the M11, M50, and City Centre. A Quality Bus Corridor runs by the development, providing fast and frequent travel to the City Centre, while the DART (Blackrock Station, 3.6km) and Luas Green Line (Stillorgan, 1.6km) are just minutes away.

description:
Cushman & Wakefield Presents: Oatlands Manor

Discover the epitome of luxury living at Oatlands Manor, an exclusive development of apartments and duplexes available to let in the heart of Mount Merrion. Nestled close to the vibrant amenities of Stillorgan, Blackrock, and Dundrum, and just 7.5km from St Stephen's Green, this prime location offers unparalleled convenience. 

Accommodation at Oatlands Manor is generous, with all units being larger than average and fitted to an exceptional standard. Enjoy the luxury of balconies or patios, as well as external courtyards. Upper-level apartments and duplexes offer stunning views of the coast and Dublin mountains.

In addition to luxury apartments, Oatlands Manor features a collection of 2 and 3-bedroom duplex units. Ground floor, own-door 3-bedroom duplexes come with a private patio to the rear and over 1,300 sq ft of living space. All units include parking, with bicycle parking and EV charging available on site.

Embrace a vibrant community lifestyle with ample leisure opportunities. At the heart of Mount Merrion lies Deerpark, a 32-acre public park perfect for dog owners, nature lovers, joggers, children, and local sports clubs. This wonderful local amenity is a joy year-round, offering magnificent views of the city and Dublin Bay.

Experience the best of Dublin living at Oatlands Manor. 

Contact Cushman & Wakefield to schedule your viewing today!
